clips.title: The story
paras: The Rite of Wisdom is the concluding trial in the traditional Rites of the Earthmother undertaken by young adventurers in Mulgore. After purifying their sight through the Rite of Vision, petitioners travel to the sacred burial grounds of Red Rocks to commune with an Ancestral Spirit and receive the blessing of the dead.

Having cleared their perception through the Rite of Vision, young protectors are directed east of Thunder Bluff toward Red Rocks. This ancient burial ground holds the physical remains and lingering spirits of those who fought and died to carve out a peaceful existence in Mulgore. Passing the trial requires approaching the resting grounds with proper reverence and communion, facing whatever territorial threats roam the hills to seek the counsel of the honored dead.

At the summit of Red Rocks, the communion with the Ancestral Spirit is not a test of martial strength, but of spiritual readiness and continuity. The spirits resting there represent the generation that fought alongside Cairne Bloodhoof to establish Thunder Bluff and safeguard the tribes. By receiving their blessing, the supplicant officially inherits the solemn duty of protecting the city, earning their place as a recognized adult and defender worthy of entering Thunder Bluff with pride.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.
Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.
Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the Rites of the Earthmother, friend.
We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty tauren who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of Thunder Bluff. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.
You have passed the Rite of Wisdom, young adventurer. Enter Thunder Bluff with pride.
